parameters: \bBeing buried in this hot sand is…\nSigh…
\rOh, you like hot springs, do you?
\rThat's surprising for one as young\nas you.
\w[signskin]Lavaridge Town Pokémon Gym\nLeader: Flannery\n“One With a Fiery Passion That Burns!”
The original games counted how many times you'd entered the hot springs
\bWe draw as much hot water as we need,\nand yet the hot springs never run dry.

These hot springs appear near active
volcanoes. Veins of water under the
ground are heated by magma to well up
as hot springs.
\rI bathe in the hot springs every day.
\rI want to become a beautiful and strong\nGym Leader like Flannery.
If a player teleports somewhere Briney isn't, Briney's position needs to be updated to prevent softlocks
\rIf people put POKéMON in hot springs,\nit might be seriously strange.
\rWhy, it might be an electric bath, or\na bubble bath, or even a lava bath…

They're claiming that these hot springs
are good for calming nervous tension,
relieving aching muscles, solving
romantic problems, and attracting
money…
\rI'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in\nhot sand by the hot springs.\nBut that doesn't seem to be enough…
\rI've heard it would be best if it were\nkept together with POKéMON and\ncarried about.
\rYou are a Trainer, yes?\nAnd your POKéMON radiate vitality.
\rSo, what say you?\nWill you take this Egg to hatch?
\rGood! I hope you'll walk plenty with\nthis here Egg!
\rOh? You've too many POKéMON.\nThere's no room for this Egg…
\rIf you have a change of heart about\nhatching this Egg, I will be here.
\rEvery so often, an Egg will be found at\nthe POKéMON Day Care.
\rOr at least that's how the rumor goes.
\bBrendan: \PN, hey, it's been a while.\nHow's it going?
\bAll right, then.\nYou may as well have this.
\bBrendan: Keep those with you if you're\nplanning on going into that desert near\nRoute 111.
\bThere should be some POKéMON that\nare exclusively desert-dwellers.\nYou might look around for those.
\bAs for me…\nI'm considering challenging Norman,\nthe Gym Leader of Petalburg.
\bUnlike you, \PN, your dad looks like\nhe really is tough.
\rOh? While I visited the hot springs,\nyou got the Lavaridge Gym Badge.
\rYou must have collected\ngood POKéMON…\nNo, I believe you raised some.
\rI guess it would be okay for you to\nhave this.
\rMay: With those Go-Goggles, you'll\nhave no trouble getting through the\ndesert near Route 111.
\rYou're trying hard because you don't\nwant to lose to me, I bet!
\r\PN, I think I should challenge\nyour dad in Petalburg Gym.
